wikidot5e:feat:wonder-maker.effectSummary: Increase Dexterity or Intelligence by 1, maximum 20. Double your proficiency bonus on checks using tinker’s tools. Your Tinker trait gains additional device options: Alarm detects a creature entering within 15 feet without the password and rings 1 round later for 1 minute, audible 300 feet; Calculator assists with arithmetic; Lifter acts as block and tackle allowing five times normal lift; Timekeeper keeps accurate time; Weather Sensor, used as an action, predicts each hour of weather in a 1-mile radius for the next 4 hours with simple symbols.

wikidot5e:feat:wood-elf-magic.effectSummary: Learn one druid cantrip plus longstrider and pass without trace. Cast longstrider and pass without trace once each without a slot per long rest. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability for all three spells.
